account.sessions.empty: No other device is signed in.
account.address.empty.title: No saved addresses

join.restaurant.title: Put your kitchen on Undal
join.restaurant.body: No listing fee. No advertising. You are ranked on food, speed and distance — never on how much you pay us.
join.restaurant.steps: Trade licence, kitchen photo, bank details. Fifteen minutes, reviewed within two working days.
join.rider.title: Deliver with Undal
join.rider.body: Motorbike or bicycle. You see the full payout before you accept, and the cash you carry is counted with you at the end of every shift.
join.note.android: The partner and rider apps run on Android. A browser cannot wake a locked phone, and we will not pretend otherwise.
partner.title: Partner console
partner.alarm.title: You are using a browser
partner.alarm.body: The Android partner app plays a loud looping alarm when an order arrives, even with the phone locked. Safari cannot. Most kitchens keep a cheap Android tablet on the counter for this.
partner.alarm.action: How to use an Android tablet
partner.empty.title: No orders right now
partner.empty.body: This board fills the moment an order lands. Keep the tab open and the sound on.
rider.title: Rider console
rider.cashNote: This is the cash you collected for Undal and have not yet handed over.
rider.shift.title: Start your shift in the app
rider.shift.body: A browser cannot keep reporting your position while the screen is off, so shifts run in the Android rider app only. Here you can see your money, invoices and documents.
seo.home.title: Undal — food delivery in {area}
seo.home.description: Order food and groceries from kitchens in {area}. Cash on delivery, live rider tracking, no advertising.
seo.vendor.description: {name} on Undal: {cuisine}. {rating}★ from {count} orders, delivered in about {minutes} minutes.
page.about.title: About Undal
page.about.body: Undal is a cash-on-delivery food and grocery platform built for Bangladesh. No vendor can buy a higher position, no customer is charged a hidden fee, and every rider sees the full payout before accepting.
page.terms.title: Terms of service
page.privacy.title: Privacy
page.privacy.body: We keep your phone number, addresses and order history to deliver your food and to satisfy tax law. We delete rider positions when a shift ends. We sell nothing to anybody.
page.licence.title: Licence
page.help.title: Help
page.contact.title: Contact
page.app.title: Get the app
page.app.body: The customer app is on Android. On an iPhone, this website does everything the app does.
page.404.title: Page not found
page.404.body: The link is broken or the page moved. The restaurants near you are one tap away.

admin.health.title: Service health
admin.orders.title: Order tower
admin.orders.empty.title: No orders yet today
admin.orders.empty.body: The tower fills as customers order. Nothing to do until then — and nothing broken.
admin.cash.title: Cash settlement queue
admin.cash.empty.title: Nothing to reconcile
admin.cash.empty.body: Riders declare cash at the end of a shift. When one does, it appears here with the evidence they attached.
admin.cash.gate.title: Cash financial writes are gated
admin.cash.gate.body: The production gate is closed until atomic posting and reconciliation are proven. This screen is read-only and says so rather than pretending.
admin.vendors.title: Vendor hub
admin.vendors.empty.title: No vendors yet
admin.vendors.empty.body: Onboarding applications appear here the moment a kitchen submits one.
admin.fleet.title: Live fleet
admin.fleet.empty.title: No riders are online
admin.fleet.empty.body: A rider appears the moment they start a shift in the app. Positions are deleted at shift end.
admin.audit.title: Audit log
admin.audit.empty.title: No entries match
admin.audit.empty.body: Every mutation writes an audit row. An empty log on an empty platform is the honest answer.
admin.zones.title: Zones
admin.zones.empty.title: No zones yet
admin.zones.empty.body: Undal delivers inside a drawn polygon. Until one exists, the storefront shows its empty state.
